gaps.sentence: He spent months ___ the application, only to be rejected in minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time doing something' takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.

gaps.sentence: He continued ___ as if nothing had happened.
gaps.explanation: continue takes -ing or to-infinitive. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: She left the room without ___ goodbye.

gaps.explanation: can't stand + -ing (also to-infinitive in AmE): can't stand waiting. -ing accepted as standard.
